verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a free developer tier: a dev instance with up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM, "No credit card required". It also documents a self-serve flow from signup to first query in about five minutes (create a cluster, connect a ClickHouse client, load data, query), so an analyst can run real queries on their own data without a sales call. Missing for 10: full tier limits (storage caps, duration, usage restrictions) are not documented, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of the no-card signup.
